validated_contract.headless: A fresh external INI launches with -s headless=yes without a visible WinUAE window, physical display enumeration, initial Direct3D probe, ROM-scan completion dialog, or crash-report dialog.
validated_contract.debugger: GDB server binds only to 127.0.0.1:2345. Bartman GDB attached to a legal-ROM 68000/ECS/1 MB no-media boot, read PC/SP and 8 bytes at 0x00fc0000, then stopped the emulator using the orderly GDB kill request.
